regions.merged_text: Mrs. Anna Kendzierski - 48 - operated on for tripple goitre (in Grace Hospital) three yrs ago, was thought to be dead. She had enrolled herself in Ser. Mass As'n before hospital. .... It was in a non Cath. hospital .... Two days after operation came to self and asked "Where is my rosary?" "O yes", the nurse answered. "They are here in the drawer. They must have saved you ... " She asks for prayers in thanksgiving - is now in ... O.K. Deo Grat.
